articles.title: U.S. Bank takes next step towards launching its stablecoin with cross-border payment test
articles.snippet: The fifth-largest U.S. commercial bank said it is exploring USBDC stablecoin for treasury payments, liquidity management and collateral after completing a live transaction.

articles.title: AI could kill us, Anthropic researcher says after resigning
articles.snippet: The people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade, Coxon said on X, explaining his resignation.

articles.title: Cronos Erased Two Hours of Transactions to Reverse $111 Million DeFi Exploit
articles.snippet: The rollback reversed legitimate activity alongside the attack, while $9.19 million remains unrecovered, according to Cronos.
